Resolves #21885

`examples/fileExplorer` is the Trees group's own example and answers "can a tree carry a real app's navigation?" It shows a small web shop's folders and files on `Neo.tree.List` beside a detail pane:

- drag a file onto a folder to move it (`Neo.draggable.tree.SortZone`);
- rename an entry in place by double-click or F2 (`Neo.list.plugin.ItemEditing`, with a validator that refuses an empty name or a slash);
- type to filter, which keeps the folders around a match;
- open `logs`, which loads its 365 files the first time it opens, even after a file was dropped into it, through the `onFolderItemClick` hook `tree.List` awaits.

The detail pane follows the entry it shows through a rename and a move. The data is a `FileStore` of `FileModel` records; a file's icon follows its name, so a rename to another extension changes it. The record opens the Trees group's own file.

Evidence: L3 (headless drives and the e2e below against a local server, at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844) → L3 required (AC-2 is interaction in a browser).

## Deltas from ticket

- The opening selection takes `Cart.mjs` by its item id, the id the tree renders. On `dev`, `tree.List` drops a selection on every render and never shows one made from a record; #21945 fixes both in PR #21948. Until that merges, a rename or a move of the selected file loses its highlight, while the detail pane keeps showing it.
- Clearing the filter opens every folder, the filter's current behaviour (defect-note filed). A folder that already shows as open while its listing loads stays open, so the toggle does not close it the moment its files arrive.
- The sort zone writes a moved record's `parentId` silently and fires `move` only on itself. The tree relays `move`, so the detail pane follows a drop.
- Trees had no group file, only the tree grids it borrows from Grid & Table. `tree.json` opens it, and the overview spec's empty-group case now keeps Trees once those grids go.
- A folder's `loaded` field says whether its listing arrived. The first cut read that from what the folder held, so a file dropped into the unopened `logs` stood in for its 365 files (Euclid's review). A failed fetch leaves `loaded` false, so the next open retries.
- `seo.json`: the `/examples/tree` and `/examples/drag-drop` descriptions take the generator's counts, 3 and 12. The generator would also rewrite routes that other merged changes moved; those stay with them.
- The e2e lives in `test/playwright/e2e/list`, the family's folder in CI's run paths; there is no `e2e/tree`.

Frame critique:

- The detail pane holds three rows for a file and leaves most of its height empty; file contents are out of scope.
- At 390 × 844 the hint wraps to three lines and the theme switch takes a row of its own.
- Mid-drag, the proxy covers part of the `services` row as it passes.
- Mid-rename, the tree shows no highlight on `README.md`, because the editor marks the row.

Locally at f5a7e4d899, the e2e passes 7 of 7 (14 of 14 run twice before `dev` was merged in), `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` passes 31 of 31, and the Portal unit tests pass 147 of 147. The new e2e test drops `README.md` into the unopened `logs`, then opens it; on 79899f15fd it fails at the listing, 1 entry where 366 are due. A probe with `logs`' first fetch failing: the folder stays closed, the next open loads its 365 files, and two opens during one slow fetch send one request.
